attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as an access-port VLAN switch: eth1 (link to node2) placed untagged in VLAN 10, eth2 (link to node3) placed untagged in VLAN 20, on a VLAN-filtering Linux bridge (br0) with per-VLAN SVIs (br0.10=192.168.10.1, br0.20=192.168.20.1). node2 (192.168.10.2) and node3 (192.168.20.2) each retain a working link to node1 in their own VLAN, while direct L2 reachability between node2 and node3 is blocked (verified even with an overlapping subnet to rule out mere subnet mismatch). Persisted config via a systemd oneshot service on node1 and NetworkManager profiles on node2/node3. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming boot-id changes and full post-restart recovery of VLAN segmentation, connectivity, and isolation.
